singleSourced.context: Reddit user SaxSlaveGael put it to work on the one bull-like boss in the game, titling their post, "There's Only One Boss that truly deserves the Matador Treatment".
The new Ash of War seemingly works with Rellana’s Cameo, which got a stealthy but major buff with Patch 1.14 almost two years ago.

That’s a nice perk

Cool but no physical no buy, especially not for $80.

singleSourced.key: changed certain items found in the field or obtained by defeating certain powerful enemies in the realm of shadow to higher tier items or other treasures
singleSourced.value: changed certain items found in the field or obtained by defeating certain powerful enemies in the Realm of Shadow to higher-tier items or other treasures.
singleSourced.context: To start with, the developer has "changed certain items found in the field or obtained by defeating certain powerful enemies in the Realm of Shadow to higher-tier items or other treasures." This won't affect stuff you've already picked up, but you'll want to keep it in mind when next exploring the Elden Ring DLC, Shadow of the Erdtree.
FromSoftware promises the frustratingly vague "improved parry performance" for the skills Parry, Storm Wall, and Thops's Barrier.

singleSourced.key: does not explode immediately upon striking terrain such as the ground or a wall
singleSourced.value: does not explode immediately upon striking terrain such as the ground or a wall.
singleSourced.context:
has been expanded, and Gravitational Missile projectile now "does not explode immediately upon striking terrain such as the ground or a wall."

A wide range of Greatshields and Towershields have been buffed, with increased guard boost on all and reduced weight for some.
Elden Ring patch 1.17 is live now, while the Tarnished Pack DLC will be released on Thursday August 27 at 3pm PT / 6pm ET / 11pm BST (Friday August 28 at midnight CEST).
